log.msg: socket-block note: page.route('**/socket*') never matches Socket.js's URL (bare ws://host, no 'socket' path segment) — routeWebSocket(/.*/,...) is the one that actually matters; used both anyway, and avoided FileSaver entirely (MemorySaver/no-saver only) so no write path existed regardless. git status public/data Server/data clean at finish.

[1] BROKEN — display:grid on root leaf, toc template (6 spans). Steps: mount panel('toc') > click leaf > open Display pop > click grid > read computed style+overlay. Expected: a column-count/auto/three/areas control. Saw: none exists anywhere (toolbar.js/properties.js/glyphs.js grepped clean); display.css:9 hardcodes .panel-d-grid to repeat(auto-fit, minmax(8em,1fr)) — the only grid ever offered. png: grid-01-display-grid.png

[1b] deeper finding, same scenario: .panel-body's grid only ever sees ONE direct child, because every T entry in templates.js wraps its content in one outer div (wall/toc/rail/etc, templates.js:62-117) — so display:grid is inert on every shipped template. Verified it DOES work on a hand-written draw() with 6 real top-level children (6 real tracks, auto-fit collapsing the rest). png: grid-01b-real-children.png

[2] BROKEN — reconfigure: gap/span/place. Steps: same leaf, open Width pop, click hug. Expected: words for gap size and a child's grid-column/row span. Saw: no 'gap' or 'span' word anywhere in ext/Panel; 'self' (place) exists and is live x+y for a grid CHILD panel, but never reaches a template's own drawn pieces (they're plain divs, not Panels). png: grid-02-reconfigure.png

[3] UNCLEAR (works structurally) — grid beside split: root->2 cols (LEFT=wall/grid, RIGHT=word/grid), seam dragged. Steps: mount blank leaf > edge-click ghost-preview attempted first, produced NO split headlessly (columns stayed 1) — fell back to item.divide('row', new Panel(), false) per ground rules, UI path logged as the miss > set LEFT/RIGHT template+display via item.set()+repaint() > screenshot 400/800/1280/1920 > real pointer drag on .panel-grip +220px. Saw: both leaves re-flowed independently, zero overflow at any width (each only ever had ONE direct child per the templates.js wrapper finding, so 'four tracks'/'two tracks' never actually appeared — same root cause as #1b). pngs: grid-03-seam-400/1280/dragged.png

[4] WORKS (as a contrast) — 6-card wall, display=grid vs display=flex, 400-1920. Saw: grid wraps (3 cols at 400, 6 at 800+, per-width overlay-verified); flex never wraps — display.css:8 '.panel-d-flex{display:flex;flex-direction:row;gap:.5em}' carries no flex-wrap at all, so 6 cards always try to fit one row (shrinking, not reflowing) at every width. pngs: grid-04-wall-grid-400/1920, grid-04-wall-flex-400.png

[5] UNCLEAR (structurally impossible as literally asked) — nested grid+split. Steps: confirmed 0 .panel-edge elements exist inside any template's drawn content (cells are div.c(...), never Panel instances — Panel.js:3-4, a leaf holds no items). Instead split the GRID LEAF's own edge: Panel.js split() (lines 81-90) moves the leaf's old data+draw down into a new first child before adding the sibling, so the grid content survives intact one level down, as a plain flex split's first child. png: grid-05-nested-split.png

[6] WORKS — fill vs hug on a grid child. w=fill body width=960px; w=hug -> --panel-hug:16em, box clamped to 256px regardless of the grid's real content width (size.css:29 min-inline-size:min(var(--panel-hug),100cqi); panel.css:11 fixes the constant at the workspace root). Confirms readme.md's own warning: hug DECLARES, never measures. png: grid-06-fill-vs-hug.png

[7] BROKEN — sow/space_dashboard can never roll a grid word. Rolled structure(seed) for 8 seeds via page.evaluate + tree walk, 0/8 had display:grid — by design, not luck: generate.js's node() (the seed->Panel translator) only ever writes {dir,grow} or {template,grow}, never 'display'; spec.js's whole vocabulary is flex-only (spec.js:27 calls its own masonry case 'a grid with extra steps', deliberately NOT reached for). No screenshot — nothing to show.

[8] WORKS — tall cell (60em) among 6, display=grid. panel-body overflow:auto (panel.css:47) scrolls the WHOLE body rather than clipping; the tall cell's own row does grow to fit it and siblings' column widths stayed level across widths (no scrollbar-steals-a-sibling's-width effect measured). pngs: grid-08-tall-400/1280.png

assign.outcome:
**ext/Panel's grid mode is one hardcoded auto-fit shape with no reconfiguration UI, and it's inert on every shipped template.** 8 scenarios, headless Playwright (own MemorySaver/no-saver harness, never the shared /data/panels.json — git status clean at finish), 4 widths each.

| # | scenario | verdict | note |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | display:grid on a leaf | broken | no UI word for column count/auto/three/areas anywhere — [grid-01](./grid-01-display-grid.png) |
| 1b | grid w/ 6 REAL children | works, but moot | every T entry wraps content in ONE div (templates.js:62-117) so grid never sees more than 1 child on any shipped template — [grid-01b](./grid-01b-real-children.png) |
| 2 | gap / span / place | broken | no 'gap' or 'span' word exists; 'self' (place) never reaches a template's own drawn pieces — [grid-02](./grid-02-reconfigure.png) |
| 3 | grid beside split, drag seam | unclear | edge-click ghost-preview didn't commit headlessly (UI miss, logged) — fell back to item.divide(); seam drag worked, both sides re-flowed, zero overflow — [grid-03](./grid-03-seam-dragged.png) |
| 4 | 6-card wall: grid vs flex | works (contrast) | grid wraps by width; flex NEVER wraps (display.css:8 has no flex-wrap) — [grid vs flex](./grid-04-wall-grid-400.png) / [flex](./grid-04-wall-flex-400.png) |
| 5 | nested split inside a grid cell | structurally impossible | a leaf holds no items (Panel.js:3-4) — cells are plain divs, never Panels; splitting the LEAF itself nests the grid one level down instead — [grid-05](./grid-05-nested-split.png) |
| 6 | fill vs hug on a grid child | works | hug DECLARES --panel-hug:16em, never measures the grid's real content — [grid-06](./grid-06-fill-vs-hug.png) |
| 7 | sow a seed with a grid word | broken | structure()'s translator (generate.js) never writes 'display' — 0/8 rolled seeds, by design not luck |
| 8 | tall cell + scroll | works | panel-body scrolls (overflow:auto), the tall row grows to fit, siblings unaffected — [grid-08](./grid-08-tall-1280.png) |

**Grid guide** (`styles/layouts/grid/`): [guide-notes.md](./guide-notes.md) — solid 3-demo bones, missing track/fr/gap/span/areas/min-width:0/dense/nested-grid steps in that order; extend in place, don't rebuild yet.
